comparison: E0-B16 to E0-B512 changes training batch only. E0-B512 and E2-B512 have matched input split, training batch, lr, seed, epoch ceiling and validation selection; architecture, aggregation, heads, parameter counts and their initial state hashes remain different. Equal ceilings are not equal total optimizer updates.
scheduling: Linux server only. Explicit GPU UUID selection; occupied GPUs require --allow-shared-gpu. Preserve E3a and all other jobs. Metadata check then a new train-only probe, separately invoked full training. Best validation checkpoint evaluated once on the existing test set; no automatic retry, resume, LR scaling or further batch search.

registration.purpose: Keep original E0 architecture and match E2-B512 training/evaluation controls. Not a parameter-matched isolation of dual encoding.
